name: emet-dev
description: Development tooling for emet: lint, format, typecheck and tests across the monorepo
author: Andry Orellana <hello@andryore.dev>

scripts.check:root: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run knip && bun run lint:docs && bun run check:map && bun run check:tree
scripts.test:root: bun test ./mods ./.claude/hooks --path-ignore-patterns 'mods/**/*.tsx' && bun test ./tools --coverage --coverage-reporter=text --coverage-reporter=lcov --coverage-dir coverage/tools && bun tools/coverage-gate.ts tools coverage/tools/lcov.info && bun test --cwd emet --coverage --coverage-reporter=text --coverage-reporter=lcov --coverage-dir ../coverage/emet && bun tools/coverage-gate.ts emet coverage/emet/lcov.info
scripts.typecheck: bun node_modules/typescript7/bin/tsc --noEmit -p emet/tsconfig.json && bun node_modules/typescript7/bin/tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.lint:commits: bun x --no-install commitlint --from "$(git merge-base origin/develop HEAD)" --to HEAD
scripts.cache:clear: bun -e "for (const path of ['node_modules/.cache', '.turbo', 'coverage']) require('node:fs').rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.fix: bun run format:write && bun run sync:site && oxlint --fix && eslint '**/*.{astro,tsx}' --max-warnings=0 --fix
scripts.ci:local: bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun install --cwd emet --frozen-lockfile && bun run check && bun run test && bun run lint:commits
